title: Onboarding probe anchoring & rollout scenario library (2025)
author: Aisha Patel
body:
> **Archived 2026-01-15:** this page is superseded by "Onboarding probe anchoring & rollout scenario library" and is kept for reference only.

Summary
A working library of probe anchoring patterns and rollout scenarios for model onboarding and promotion. It explains how to bind probes to service slices, how to read multi-signal telemetry during staged rollouts, and which rollback/mitigation steps to take. The aim is consistent, auditable onboarding decisions for mixed-latency, quantized and cache-sensitive models.

Scope
- Hosted, Dedicated and Private deployment onboarding.
- Probes run by the eval harness, shadow load and canary traffic.
- Quantization-aware probes and basic cache warmup probes.
- Complements (does not replace) service-specific SLO documents by defining probe-to-SLO anchoring.

Why anchoring matters
Anchoring connects a probe result to an explicit accept/rollback decision. Without it, teams compare the wrong signals (for example token-level coherence against p95 latency). Anchors make sure the right contract is enforced for quality, latency, token cost and stability under quantization and caching.

Key concepts
- Anchor: binding between a probe (inputs + measurement) and a service slice or SLO.
- Probe family: curated probes targeting one failure class (e.g., long-context coherence).
- Anchor contract: signals, thresholds and aggregation used to accept or roll back.
- Warmup probe: primes the KV cache and model kernels for stable performance.

Scenario catalog
1) Latency-sensitive canary (user-facing API route)
- Anchor: route=predictive-text, SLO=p95_latency<=300ms
- Probes: short prompt micro-bursts sized like real traffic (avg token <= 20)
- Signals: p95/p99 latency, error rate, streaming-backpressure events
- Accept: p95 <= 300ms AND error_rate < 0.5% over 10k requests; p99 > 600ms triggers mitigation.

2) Coherence-first shadow rollout
- Anchor: service_slice=document-summarization, SLO=semantic-fidelity-delta<=0.05 (vs baseline)
- Probes: long-context summaries scored by embedding cosine plus human anchoring, n=5 seeds
- Signals: mean fidelity_delta, coherence-stability-index (95% CI), annotator disagreement
- Accept: fidelity_delta <= 0.05 AND annotator_disagreement <= 12% over 2k probes.

3) Quantization-focused rollout
- Anchor: quant_profile=q8_2, SLO=per-token-coherence-resilience>=0.98
- Probes: adversarial priming and perturbation noise sweep
- Signals: coherence-regression-rate, token entropy shift, memory-alloc failures on 2 GPU types
- Accept: coherence-regression-rate < 2% and zero alloc failures in a 1k-run smoke test.

4) Cold-start guard
- Anchor: tenant_tier=dedicated, SLO=cold-start-p95 <= 500ms after 30s idle
- Probes: representative multi-turn session bursts
- Signals: cold-start_p95, per-call latency increase, cache-hit-rate
- Accept: cache_hit_rate >= 85% after warmup AND cold-start_p95 <= 500ms.

Decision matrix (signals -> action)
Aggregate over the canary window. Binding for promotions through the standard onboarding pipeline.
| Signal (window) | Green | Yellow | Red | Action |
|-----------------|-------|--------|-----|--------|
| p95 latency (30m) | <=300ms | 300-450ms | >450ms | Continue / Hold / Rollback |
| fidelity_delta (2k probes) | <=0.05 | 0.05-0.08 | >0.08 | Promote / Investigate / Rollback |
| error rate (30m) | <=0.5% | 0.5-1.5% | >1.5% | Continue / Hold & throttle / Rollback & throttle |
| coherence-regression-rate | <2% | 2-5% | >5% | Promote-small / Annotation repair / Rollback + freeze |

Anchoring templates
- SLO anchor:
  - anchor_id: <service>-<slice>-<probe_family>
  - primary_metrics: [metric1, metric2, ...]
  - aggregation: rolling_mean/median/p95 over <window>
  - decision_thresholds: {green: X, yellow: Y, red: Z}
  - telemetry_sources: [prod-metrics, eval-harness, shadow-trace]

- Probe-job spec:
  ```yaml
  probe_job:
    name: kv-warmup-primer-v1
    anchor: inference-service/document-summarization-kv-warmup
    schedule: one-off
    parallelism: 40
    sample_bucket: prod-replay/tenant-priority-1
    run_timeout: 120s
    metrics_emit: [latency_ms,p99_latency,cache_hits,error_rate]
    artifact_retention: 30d
  ```

Telemetry best practices
- Use deltas vs baseline for quality metrics; use absolute thresholds for latency.
- Declare primary and fallback sources (primary=prod-metrics, fallback=shadow-mesh, tertiary=eval-harness).
- Bootstrap non-deterministic probes with n>=5 seeds and report mean+CI.
- Human-anchor the first 500 failing probes of any semantic scoring probe.

Rollout playbook
1) Preflight
   - Run quant and unit-fidelity checks locally (min 1k synthetic seeds).
   - Check artifact signature and quant_profile metadata.
   - Publish the anchor contract to the onboarding tracker.
2) Shadow stage
   - Run a 12h shadow against 1% of production traffic.
   - Fire warmup probes in the first 10 minutes.
   - Any Red-level signal stops the shadow and opens a regression ticket.
3) Micro-canary
   - Serve 0.5% traffic from internal test accounts, running the probe family at 5x rate.
   - Hold at least 2 business hours or until 10k probe samples exist.
4) Gradual ramp
   - 1% -> 5% -> 20% -> 50% -> 100%, 30-60 minutes per step, re-evaluating the anchor contract each time.
5) Post-promote monitoring
   - Nightly targeted probes on high-risk slices for 72 hours after 100%.

Rollback & mitigation
- Red fidelity_delta: roll back to the previous pinned model and raise a regression alert with probe artifacts and top-50 failing inputs.
- Latency regression with quality OK: throttle non-critical routes, route bursts to dedicated capacity, roll forward a kernel-optimized variant if one exists.
- Quant-induced memory allocation errors: drop to a lower quant profile on the affected fleet and schedule re-tuning.

Regression triage (Yellow/Red)
1) Collect probe inputs, model version, quant_profile, kernel selection logs and traces for the slowest 5 requests.
2) Reproduce with a local micro-replay using the same seeds.
3) Bisect model versions / quant variants if a shadow cohort exists.
4) Prompt-sensitive causes: tag "prompt-failure" and send top-20 failing prompts to prompt engineering.
5) Infra causes (GPU OOM, slow kernel): assign to the runtime team with kernel profile and traces.

Ownership and auditability
- Each anchor contract lists owner (pager/team), primary contact email and a rollout changelog.
- Tag probe jobs with anchor_id, model_version, quant_profile and commit_sha.
- Probe artifacts are retained for 30 days by default and 365 days for enterprise-sensitive tenants.

FAQ
Q: How many probes per canary?
A: At least 10k executions for latency-sensitive routes and 2k for semantic/coherence probes. Low-volume tenants can use the probe fabricator for synthetic probes.

Q: Can we promote with one Yellow metric?
A: Yes, with documented mitigations and a hold period defined in the anchor contract (e.g., limited-rate promote + 24h close monitoring).

CLI snippets
  $ ri probe run --job kv-warmup-primer-v1 --anchor inference-service/document-summarization-kv-warmup --parallel 40 --timeout 120s
  $ ri metrics query --anchor inference-service/document-summarization-kv-warmup --window 24h --agg p95,mean,error_rate
